figurative_meaning_en: Small in appearance but skilled in mischief or devilish acts
example_sentences_in_bangla: সেই ছেলেটি খুদে শয়তান, সবসময় দুষ্টুমি করে।
এই খুদে শয়তানটি আবার কী করেছে দেখো!
example_sentences_in_english: That boy is a little devil, always up to mischief.
Look what this little imp has done again!
note: Refers to someone small but troublesome, often used affectionately for children
